描述_EN: a print of such large scale, with even and perfect tonal effects, represents a high level of technical accomplishment. water symbolises simplicity, memory and human virtues. water is a time-honoured image in chinese art and philosophy, but is rarely the main subject of chinese works of art.images of water pervade ancient chinese culture. in this large woodblock, chen qi departs from convention by devoting the entire artwork to the theme of water, and the work becomes a piece of abstract contemplation.this woodblock print invites the viewer to contemplate the abstract qualities of water.
描述_ZN: 如此大规模的印刷品，具有均匀完美的色调效果，代表了高水准的技术成就。 水象征着简单、记忆和人类的美德。 水在中国艺术和哲学中是一个历史悠久的形象，但很少是中国艺术作品的主要主题，水的形象充斥着中国古代文化。 在这幅大型木版画中，陈琦打破常规，将整幅作品用于水的主题，作品成为一幅抽象的沉思作品。
